questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to hire an assistant on a permanent contract. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the rules. According to Article 16 of the Labor Code, what is the general principle for the duration of the employment contract?
options: The contract is always concluded for a fixed term
The contract is concluded for an indefinite period by default
The contract must be renewed each month
The contract cannot exceed one year
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 16 provides that the employment contract is concluded for an indefinite period by default, the principle being the indefinite period.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will therefore offer a permanent contract.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki wishes to replace an assistant on maternity leave. Dr. Mourad advises her on the type of contract. According to Article 16, what contract can she conclude?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 16 provides for the fixed-term contract particularly in the case of replacing an employee in the event of suspension of the employment contract.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will conclude a fixed-term replacement contract.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant on a probation period for 3 weeks. He wishes to dismiss her. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the rules. According to Article 13, what notice period must he respect if she is paid monthly?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 13 provides for a notice period of 8 days for employees paid monthly during the probation period after one week of work.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will respect this deadline.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki wishes to hire a manager. Dr. Mourad asks her about the duration of the probation period. According to Article 14, what is the maximum duration for a manager?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 14 sets the probation period at three months for managers, renewable once.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will plan for 3 months for my new manager.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee on an 8-month fixed-term contract. Dr. Sidki asks him if a probation period is possible. According to Article 14, what is the maximum duration of the probation period for this fixed-term contract?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 14 provides for one month of probation period for fixed-term contracts of more than 6 months.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will plan for one month of probation.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki wishes to dismiss an assistant for gross misconduct. Dr. Mourad informs her of the grounds. According to Article 39, an unjustified absence of how many days constitutes gross misconduct?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 39 considers as gross misconduct an unjustified absence for more than four days.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will check the absences.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant who committed gross misconduct. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the procedure. According to Article 62, within what period must he hear her?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 62 provides that the employee must be heard within a maximum period of 8 days after the notification of the act.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will summon the assistant quickly.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on a permanent contract for 18 months. She wishes to dismiss her for economic reasons. Dr. Mourad asks her if the assistant is entitled to severance pay. According to Article 52, what is the answer?
options: No, because she has less than 2 years of seniority
Yes, because she has worked at least 6 months
Yes, but only if the dismissal is for misconduct
No, economic reasons exclude severance pay
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 52 provides for the right to severance pay after six months of work in the same company.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will therefore pay her the severance pay.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an assistant who regularly works overtime. Dr. Sidki informs him about the supplements. According to Article 201, what is the supplement rate for overtime worked between 6am and 9pm?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 201 provides for a 25% supplement for overtime between 6am and 9pm.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will calculate the overtime correctly.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on maternity leave. Dr. Mourad asks her about the duration of the leave. According to Article 152, what is the duration of maternity leave?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 152 provides for maternity leave of fourteen weeks.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will respect this duration.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to suspend his assistant for 5 days. Dr. Sidki informs him of the limits. According to Article 37, disciplinary suspension cannot exceed:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 37 provides that disciplinary suspension cannot exceed eight days.' Dr. Mourad: '5 days is therefore possible.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on a 10-month fixed-term contract who becomes pregnant. Dr. Mourad informs her about the end of the contract. According to Article 159, does the fixed-term contract end at its term?
options: Yes, it ends at its term
No, it is converted into a permanent contract
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 159 provides that the protective provisions for pregnant women do not prevent the expiry of the fixed-term contract.' Dr. Sidki: 'The contract will therefore end at its term.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who resigned. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the formalities. According to Article 72, within what period must he issue the work certificate?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 72 requires the employer to issue the work certificate within a maximum period of eight days.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will prepare it immediately.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an employee who refuses to perform dangerous work. Dr. Mourad informs her about the employee's rights. According to Article 293, can the employee be sanctioned?
options: Yes, if they have been informed of the risks
No, they can refuse any work
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 293 provides that employees informed of safety requirements who do not comply with them are liable to sanctions.' Dr. Sidki: 'I must first inform them of the risks.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, employer of 15 employees, wishes to establish internal regulations. Dr. Sidki informs him of the obligations. According to Article 138, what is the deadline to establish internal regulations?
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 138 provides that the employer employing at least 10 employees must establish internal regulations within two years of opening.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will draft them.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant who is entitled to annual leave. Dr. Mourad asks her about the duration. According to Article 231, paid annual leave is:
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 231 sets annual leave at one and a half days of actual work per month of service.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will calculate my assistant's leave.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad wishes to hire a foreign employee. Dr. Sidki informs him about the procedure. According to Article 516, what authorization is required?
options: Authorization from the government authority responsible for labor
Authorization from the Ministry of Interior
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 516 requires obtaining authorization from the government authority responsible for labor to recruit a foreign employee.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will make the request.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant who works overtime at night. Dr. Mourad informs her about the supplements. According to Article 201, what is the rate for night hours?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 201 provides for a 50% supplement for overtime worked between 9pm and 6am.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will apply this rate.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee on a permanent contract who wishes to resign. Dr. Sidki reminds him of the formalities. According to Article 34, the resignation must be:
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 34 provides that resignation must be made by a letter bearing a signature legalized by the competent authority.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will wait for the official letter.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 60 employees, wishes to create a medical service. Dr. Mourad informs her of her obligations. According to Article 304, what must she do?
options: Provide a simple first aid kit
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 304 requires the creation of an independent occupational medical service for companies employing at least 50 employees.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will create this service.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who committed gross misconduct. Dr. Sidki asks him if he must pay compensation. According to Article 61, does dismissal for gross misconduct exempt from payment?
options: Yes, but notice indemnity is due
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 61 provides that in the event of gross misconduct, the employee may be dismissed without notice or indemnity.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will therefore pay nothing.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki has an assistant on a 5-month fixed-term contract. Dr. Mourad asks her about the duration of the probation period. According to Article 14, the probation period for a fixed-term contract of less than 6 months is:
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 14 provides for two weeks of probation period for fixed-term contracts of less than 6 months.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will plan for 2 weeks of probation.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad has an employee who refuses to comply with safety rules. Dr. Sidki informs him about possible sanctions. According to Article 293, is this refusal sanctionable?
options: No, the employee has the right to refuse
Yes, if they have been informed of the rules
Yes, only if an accident occurs
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Article 293 provides that employees informed of safety rules who do not comply with them are liable to sanctions.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will remind them of the rules.'

questions.question: Dr. Sidki, employer of 25 employees, must organize staff delegate elections. According to Article 433, how many delegates must she have?
questions.explanation: Dr. Mourad explains: 'Article 433 provides that between 10 and 25 employees, the company must elect one titular delegate and one alternate.' Dr. Sidki: 'I will organize these elections.'

questions.question: Dr. Mourad, after managing several HR aspects with Dr. Sidki, receives her congratulations. What is the next step for Dr. Mourad?
options: Become an expert in dental HR management
questions.explanation: Dr. Sidki explains: 'Mastery of HR management is a valuable skill. Becoming an expert is the next step.' Dr. Mourad: 'I will train in human resources management.'
